body:
Since it's related, with GCC 15.2.1 on Fedora and `warnings=extra werror=yes`, I get this error:
```
In file included from ./core/profiling/profiling.h:52,
                 from ./core/os/memory.cpp:33,
                 from core/os/.scu/scu_core_os.gen.cpp:3:
./core/os/memory.cpp: In function 'void* Memory::alloc_static(size_t, bool) [with bool p_ensure_zero = false]':
/home/akien/Godot/toolchains/tracy/public/tracy/Tracy.hpp:222:67: error: 'mem' may be used uninitialized [-Werror=maybe-uninitialized]
  222 | #define TracyAlloc( ptr, size ) tracy::Profiler::MemAllocCallstack( ptr, size, TRACY_CALLSTACK, false )
      |                                 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
./core/profiling/profiling.h:79:42: note: in expansion of macro 'TracyAlloc'
   79 | #define GodotProfileAlloc(m_ptr, m_size) TracyAlloc(m_ptr, m_size)
      |                                          ^~~~~~~~~~
./core/os/memory.cpp:115:9: note: in expansion of macro 'GodotProfileAlloc'
  115 |         GodotProfileAlloc(mem, p_bytes + (prepad ? DATA_OFFSET : 0));
      |         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
In file included from /home/akien/Godot/toolchains/tracy/public/tracy/../client/TracyLock.hpp:9,
                 from /home/akien/Godot/toolchains/tracy/public/tracy/Tracy.hpp:133:
/home/akien/Godot/toolchains/tracy/public/tracy/../client/TracyProfiler.hpp:519:36: note: by argument 1 of type 'const void*' to 'static void tracy::Profiler::MemAllocCallstack(const void*, size_t, int32_t, bool)' declared here
  519 |     static tracy_force_inline void MemAllocCallstack( const void* ptr, size_t size, int32_t depth, bool secure )
      |                                    ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```

I'd suggest working it around in this PR since it's touching the same code, using:
```
diff --git a/core/profiling/profiling.h b/core/profiling/profiling.h
index 43d50c2bb0..44ef21189c 100644
--- a/core/profiling/profiling.h
+++ b/core/profiling/profiling.h
@@ -76,7 +76,10 @@ const tracy::SourceLocationData *intern_source_location(const void *p_function_p
 	tracy::ScopedZone __godot_tracy_zone_##m_group_name(TracyInternal::intern_source_location(m_ptr, m_file, m_function, m_line))
 
 // Memory allocation
-#define GodotProfileAlloc(m_ptr, m_size) TracyAlloc(m_ptr, m_size)
+#define GodotProfileAlloc(m_ptr, m_size)                       \
+	GODOT_GCC_WARNING_PUSH_AND_IGNORE("-Wmaybe-uninitialized") \
+	TracyAlloc(m_ptr, m_size);                                 \
+	GODOT_GCC_WARNING_POP
 #define GodotProfileFree(m_ptr) TracyFree(m_ptr)
 
 void godot_init_profiler();
```
(not an exact diff for this PR as I tested on `master`)
